stem: What is the most likely reason the poet uses this figurative language?
instruction:
Read line 16 of the poem “Don’t Go Into the Library.”

The deli offerings of civilization itself.

options.label: A
options.text: To imply that not all library books are appealing

options.label: B
options.text: To suggest that libraries are not as popular as they once were

options.label: C
options.text: To convey the idea that there are many options in the library

options.label: D
options.text: To share the importance of certain topics found in the library

visual_elements: The deli offerings of civilization itself.
